text: {"verdict": "BLOCK", "rule": "I2", "rationale": "Under synthesis, deposit_composition and get_loaded_plate are both allowed. However, six depositions each put 100% of a single element (index 11) at thickness 1. Reading consumption as fraction times thickness, that element totals 6 target-units, over the 5.0-per-campaign limit. The rules do not define this conversion explicitly, but it is the natural reading."}
